sources.excerpt: Bilmuri x Tallon Electric - The Hog Skip to content Home Products Contact About Search More Home Products Contact About More Search Account Cart 0 The Hog Wield the tone of BILMURI 126 reviews Kinda Hard Motorsports The Hog Nighthog Edition $189.00 ADD TO CART THE HOG employs a dangerous blend of distortion and overdrive to produce tones that are THICC and CRYSTAL CLEAR . CONTROLS: + CRANK: Controls the gain of the distortion tone OPTIMIZE: Blends between the distortion tone (ccw) and the crunch tone (cw) LOAD: Sets the total output volume CLARITY: Cuts or boosts the overall brightness BEEF: Set upward for ultimate lows, or downward for a tighter bass response SECRET SWITCH: Open your pedal to find a secret setting! The Hog was tailored for use with single coil pickups. Slide this switch to the right when using higher output pickups to clean up your crunch tone. TECH SPECS: + POWER SUPPLY NOT INCLUDED . Batteries not accepted. 9VDC, 2.1mm center negative power required Power consumption: 20mA Soft touch momentary footswitch Enclosure size: 4.7" x 3.75" x 1.75" VIEW OPERATION MANUAL (PDF) → SEE IT IN ACTION CUSTOMER REVIEWS Customer Reviews Based on 126 reviews Write a review 98% (124) 1% (1) 1% (1) 0% (0) 0% (0) E Ethan This pedal cranks my hog SO mf’n hard This pedal. Wow. This pedal, just wow. I have never bought a pedal from a small manufacturer and I was completely blown away. Its gorgeous, sounds fantastic and I even used it on my own recordings. Tallon Electric is killer, shipped fast and is an incredible human. I will absolutely be buying more pedals from Tallon! S Sam Really great do-all pedal! It rips!!! If you aren't sure what sound you want, The Hog gives you great overdrive and distortion, depending on how you EQ it. It's definitely full, and fattens up the sound much more than just the dirt channel on my Marshall. I mostly play pop-punk rhythms, but it handles drop-A on a 7-string just fine without bottoming out. I still haven't figured out how to get the exact Bilmuri snappy sound yet, but I also don't play a Strat. There's plenty I haven't figured out with this pedal, but that's the best part. 5/5 for fit, finish, and overall experience. Will be buying from Tallon again! R Raistlin This is my go to pedal now It looks cool, it sounds mean af, what more could you want? If you’re looking for that Bilmuri sound, this is the way to go. Buy one and get crankin today bois A Alex Completely stunned! I am just starting to understand, what The Hog is capable of doing. Love it so much. Thanks you a thousand times! Especially for the light speed shipping to Germany. Take care, much love for you guys !! N Nick Awesome I received the pedal super fast, within 3 days (from America to the Netherlands). Safely packet for the journey.
